seo.description_so: Bajaaj ma u baahan tahay? Taabo, waa kuu soo socotaa. Ku dalbo Bajaaj Garoowe, arag qiimaha ka hor, oo la soco darawalkaaga.
seo.description_en: Need a Bajaaj? Tap. It's on the way. Book a Bajaaj in Garowe, see the fare first, and track your driver.

so.headline: Bajaaj ma u baahan tahay? Taabo, waa kuu soo socotaa.
so.sub: Ku dalbo Bajaaj meel kasta oo aad u socoto Garoowe. Qiimaha waxaad arkaysaa ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.

en.headline: Need a Bajaaj? Tap. It's on the way.
en.sub: Book a Bajaaj to take you anywhere in Garowe. You see the fare before you confirm.

steps.title: Dooro meelaha
steps.body: Qor meesha aad joogto iyo meesha aad u socoto. Haddii cinwaan sax ah aadan haysan, biinka khariidadda ka dhig oo qor calaamad u dhow.

steps.title: Xaqiiji qiimaha
steps.body: Qiimaha oo dhammaystiran ayaa lagu tusayaa. Xaqiiji haddii aad ku qanacsan tahay.

steps.title: Darawalku waa soo socdaa
steps.body: Darawalka ugu dhow ayaa helaya codsigaaga. Waxaad arkaysaa magaciisa, koodhka gaariga, taarikada iyo meesha uu joogo.

steps.title: Bixi oo qiimee
steps.body: Bixi lacag caddaan ah marka safarku dhammaado. Qiimee darawalka si aan adeegga u wanaajino.

steps.title: Choose your places
steps.body: Type where you are and where you're going. If you don't have an exact address, drop a pin and add a nearby landmark.

steps.title: Confirm the fare
steps.body: The full fare is shown. Confirm if you're happy with it.

steps.title: Your driver is on the way
steps.body: The nearest driver receives your request. You see their name, fleet code, plate and live location.

steps.title: Pay and rate
steps.body: Pay cash when the trip ends. Rate your driver to help us keep the service good.

so.title: Waxa aad ka filan karto safar kasta
so.body:
- Qiimo cad oo ku salaysan masaafada waddada, la tusay ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
- Darawal la hubiyay oo leh koodh gaari oo muuqda (tusaale BG-0142).
- La socod toos ah oo khariidad ah, iyo xiriirin aad la wadaagi karto qof aad ku kalsoon tahay.
- Badhanka gurmadka (SOS) app-ka dhexdiisa haddii wax dhacaan.
- Lacag caddaan ah; lacag-bixinta mobaylka waa la soo dari doonaa marka ay diyaar noqoto.

en.title: What to expect on every ride
en.body:
- A clear fare based on road distance, shown before you confirm.
- A verified driver with a visible fleet code (for example BG-0142).
- Live tracking on a map, and a link you can share with someone you trust.
- An in-app emergency (SOS) button if something goes wrong.
- Cash payment; mobile money will be added when it is ready.

so.title: Qiyaas qiimaha safarkaaga
so.body: Qor masaafada oo arag inta uu safarku kugu kacayo.

en.title: Estimate your fare
en.body: Type a distance and see what the trip would cost.
